# Anvil masonry sources

The recipe and tag files are exact generated JSON from Tinkers' Construct at
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`, under the existing TConstruct MIT
license and attribution. `manifest.json` records source links and SHA-256 hashes.

`native_unchanged_fields.json` records the prior native recipe fields after
removing only `key.s`. It guards unchanged metal selectors, costs, output and
components across all 36 recipes. These native fingerprints are not claims that
all legacy recipe behavior matches the source.
